problem_type: Generated pre-push hooks assume an optional repository script exists
symptom: A pre-push hook generated in a worktree without scripts/ponytail-review-hook.mjs fails before the push can proceed.
direct_cause: renderHookContent emits an unconditional node invocation for the Ponytail runner without checking that the target exists below the worktree root.
class_root: The generated pre-push contract has no existence guard for its optional review runner, so sparse, trimmed, or otherwise script-incomplete worktrees execute a missing file.
affected_population: Worktrees that do not contain scripts/ponytail-review-hook.mjs
Developers installing hooks from a sparse or partial checkout
Future generated pre-push hooks using the same optional runner
entry_points: scripts/install-git-hooks.cjs installHooks writing the generated pre-push file
internal_only_reason: This is an internal shell-template invariant; no third-party protocol or dependency version determines whether a repository-local script exists.
invariants: Every generated pre-push hook checks for the repository-local Ponytail runner before invoking it.
A missing optional runner exits successfully without attempting a missing node entrypoint.
The pre-commit secret scan remains independent and runs before its Ponytail invocation.
generality_proof: All generated pre-push files are rendered by renderHookContent and installed through installHooks; placing the existence guard in that renderer covers direct rendering and every installer write, regardless of why the worktree lacks the optional script.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Emit the fail-safe pre-push shell template before any optional Ponytail command can run.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The renderer is the single source of generated hook text and now emits the exact file guard before the runner command.
installHooks writes the renderer output to the selected hook directory, so installed hooks inherit the same guard.

recurrence.reason: Any sparse, partial, generated, or future worktree that omits a repository-local optional runner can reproduce the same missing-entrypoint failure.
same_class_scan: Searched the installer HOOKS definitions and renderHookContent for every generated pre-push command.
Checked installHooks as the separate write path that materializes renderHookContent output.
Checked the existing pre-push test fixture, which intentionally creates a repository without the Ponytail script.

prevention.invariant: A generated pre-push hook must verify the optional Ponytail runner exists before invoking node.
prevention.failure_mode: If the runner is absent, the hook exits 0 and does not call a missing file.
prevention.strategy: Keep the exact file check in the shared hook renderer, so every installed pre-push artifact receives the same fail-safe behavior without weakening pre-commit secret scanning.

legacy_paths.rationale: No legacy implementation is retained; the existing generated pre-push command remains the only runner path and gains the shared guard.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The failure is caused by a missing repository-local file and shell-template behavior, not by a third-party runtime version.

migration: Existing hook files are regenerated by the normal pnpm postinstall hook; no user data or persisted project state needs migration.
residual_risks: A manually edited pre-push hook outside the installer remains outside this source-controlled template and must be regenerated to receive the guard.
